plugins.name: sideboard
plugins.description: Your GitHub Issues as a live roadmap board pinned beside Claude Code chat — filed, moved, and closed by Claude as you work, plus code-aware commands to suggest, sequence, and clean up the backlog. Runs a local board server on 127.0.0.1 and installs session hooks (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit) so the pane follows your active project.
